audit.whatIsWrong: On disk the chart reads Darius, Skill, Singed, Singed, Darius, Singed, Singed — it hands Singed level 3 and levels 4-5 on the only losing lane in this slice (49.91% over 2200 games).
audit.why: The entry's own reasoning contradicts it: whys[1] says his bleed window beats your engage window, whys[2] says Apprehend hard-counters your run-past and you cannot re-establish distance, and whys[3] says outright 'the lane itself is still his'. Meanwhile whys[5] calls the first-item 1v1 'genuinely even' and whys[6] calls two items 'a skill matchup'. The chart is inverted relative to the text at four rows.
audit.corrected: Darius, Darius, Darius, Darius, Darius, Skill, Skill on both layers — proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Apprehend' is the entire plan and the cooldown is never given, so the reader has no idea how long the window lasts.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26 seconds at rank 1 — the longest ability cooldown in this lane by a wide margin. That single number turns 'when it is down, commit' from a slogan into a 26-second proxy window. Decimate is 9s, Crippling Strike 5s, Noxian Guillotine 120s at rank 1, and the Guillotine refreshes if it kills.
audit.corrected: 26s Apprehend, 9s Decimate and 120s Guillotine written into the cooldown row, report[5], whys[2], wants.foe[1] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is missing entirely: Decimate heals Darius off every champion hit by the blade, and Insanity Potion puts Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail, which halves it. Nothing on either layer mentions his healing at all. Also 'root him in the goo and Fling him' has the sequence backwards — the adhesive slows and grounds, and the root only exists when Fling drops him inside it.
audit.why: Riot text — Darius Q: 'Darius heals based on enemy champions and large monsters hit by the blade.' Singed R: 'making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds'. Singed E: 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' Darius R: 'If Noxian Guillotine is a killing blow, its cooldown is refreshed for a brief duration' — which is why a Guillotine on your teammate is not a cooldown you can count on.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal against Decimate stated in three places, the Fling-into-adhesive root sequenced correctly, and the Guillotine reset written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Crippling Strike is described only as a slow.
audit.why: It is an auto-attack reset, so his damage arrives on the swing wind-up rather than on a visible cast — the tell to walk on is the attack animation, not the ability.

- Darius Apprehend (26s at rank 1): his all-in start, and the longest cooldown here — that is your window. - Decimate (9s) heals off the blade edge. - Noxian Guillotine (120s) refreshes on a kill. - Insanity Potion: 100s.
26s at rank 1 — his all-in start. Don't get pulled; engage once it is down.
Track Apprehend (26s at rank 1): his all-in start. Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds halves his Decimate heal.
Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds halves Decimate's heal at 6 — but Noxian Guillotine is true damage and refreshes on a kill, so never sit low.
Hold Mega Adhesive for the moment after Apprehend lands, then Fling him into the goo — landing inside it roots him and he eats the cloud on the way back
Stack five Hemorrhage bleeds and fire Noxian Guillotine (120s) for the true-damage execute — and if it kills, the cooldown refreshes at once
Apprehend (E) is online and it is 26s at rank 1 — the pull hard-counters your run-past, but once he spends it you own the lane for the next half minute.
His first item lands before your Rylai's and the shred plus slow can catch you inside the cloud — but Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds halves the Decimate heal that wins him long fights.

At level 1 you have Poison Trail and nothing else — Darius already has Decimate, healing off the blade of every Q and building Hemorrhage. Do not step into melee for any reason; last-hit at max Q distance and accept the poke. Level 2 brings Fling, but he gets Crippling Strike, which is an auto-attack reset, so the tell is the swing wind-up rather than a cast bar — and his slow into bleed stacks still beats your engage. Level 3 adds Mega Adhesive and the real sequence: glue his feet first, then Fling him into the goo, because landing inside the adhesive is what roots him. Apprehend still answers all of it at 26 seconds, so never let five Hemorrhage stacks accumulate — one clean Decimate already puts you at three, and the execute goes live from there.

Levels 4 and 5 are where Singed starts to matter — not by fighting, but by proxying. Send Poison Trail through the wave behind his back line, steal the gold, and force Darius to choose between killing you, which he cannot do without Apprehend, and losing CS. Apprehend is 26 seconds at rank 1: the moment it is spent you have almost half a minute of free lane, and that is the window to run the pattern. At level 6, Insanity Potion is not a health bar — it is Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail, halving the Decimate heal that carries his long trades. Noxian Guillotine is still true damage and still lethal on a bled target, so use your ultimate to extend a run-past, never to dive. When Apprehend is up, give him nothing at all.

notes: This entry names every ability correctly, which is rare in this champion's data — the two real gaps were numbers and healing. Apprehend at 26s is the single most useful number in the matchup and it appeared nowhere. Decimate's heal, and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds cutting it, were also absent from both layers despite being the reason a Singed ultimate matters here at all. I did not touch the itemisation strings (Stridebreaker / Black Cleaver in whys[4] I left in place) since I cannot verify 26.15 build trends from local files. Level chart was inverted against the entry's own whys at four rows and against a sub-50% win rate; corrected to Darius through level 6, Skill on both item stages.
